citations.quote: Was not sure why I did this video last year in Vietnam… But this is really me… re-starting myself again from 0 on a new level. Being born in a small city… I’m the end of Communism regime, would never believe I would be where I’m now. Never had it easy… But now I’m so thankful that I never had - a privilege passport - perfect English - rich husband And if put all my experiences together I’ve been living 5 lives Growing up in a Small city, moved to capital at 20, moved to India at 30, moved to Dubai at 34, started my own business at 40. And Now I feel I’m back to 0 on another level. Building my media and coaching Empire….

summary.text: The author expresses a sense of disbelief about their current status, given their origins in a small city at the end of the Communist regime, and lists several personal milestones such as moving from a small city to various major cities and starting a business.
